title: Shattered Fox Mosaic
description: A stylized black fox with glowing yellow eyes and pink accents stands in the center of a fragmented, stained-glass style composition. The image is divided into irregular geometric panels containing various objects including a red lamp, paintbrushes, colorful spheres, fruit, and abstract patterns against a predominantly black background.
prompt: A black fox with glowing yellow eyes and pink markings stands upright in the center of a shattered stained-glass composition. The image is broken into irregular geometric shards containing symbolic objects like a red desk lamp, blue paintbrushes, colorful spheres, fruit, and abstract patterns. Vibrant teal, magenta, and yellow details contrast sharply against the black background in a modern mosaic art style.
